	<div   class='main_color container_wrap_first container_wrap sidebar_right'  ><div class='container av-section-cont-open' ><main  role="main" itemprop="mainContentOfPage"  class='template-page content  av-content-small alpha units'><div class='post-entry post-entry-type-page post-entry-146'><div class='entry-content-wrapper clearfix'><section  class='av_textblock_section av-k9cwpgi3-4f82d143f3257677ac1679623ae5254a '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p style="text-align: justify;">Our Kiteboarding school in Costa Rica provide kitesurfing courses and rentals at incredible prices. Our main concern is to obtain a high level of quality training for our students. We will put all our efforts to get what you need!</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">We have a wide range of Kiteboarding courses and rentals for all levels and adapted to all situations. All our instructor are  <img decoding="async" class="alignnone wp-image-380" src="https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/07/IKO_international_kiteboarding_organization.png" alt="Logo IKO Courses and Rentals" width="100" height="30" srcset="https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/07/IKO_international_kiteboarding_organization.png 363w, https://costakite.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/07/IKO_international_kiteboarding_organization-300x90.png 300w" sizes="(max-width: 100px) 100vw, 100px" />  (International Kiteboarding organization) certified.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">Our kiteboarding school in Costa Rica arrange custom lessons including accommodation. In case that you need it please <a title="Contact" href="https://costakite.com/contact/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">contact us</a>. Besides courses and rentals we also provide shuttles from other places in Costa Rica.</p>

<h2 style="text-align: center;">STEPS TO LEARN IN OUR KITEBOARDING SCHOOL IN COSTA RICA</h2>
<p style="text-align: left;"><span class="Apple-style-span" style="color: #121416;"><div id="squelch-taas-toggle-0" class="squelch-taas-toggle squelch-taas-override" data-speed="800" data-active="false" data-theme="jqueryui" ></span></p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><span class="Apple-style-span" style="color: #121416;"> <h3 id="squelch-taas-header-0" class="squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-header"><a href="#squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-content-0">Basic flying skills</a></h3><div id="squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-content-0" class="squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-content squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-content-0"></span></p>
<ul>
<li>Spot Selection.</li>
<li>Equipment Introduction.</li>
<li>Free Flying the kite.</li>
<li>Wind window theory.</li>
<li>First kite fly at Edge of wind window.</li>
<li>Wind Window Check points.</li>
<li>8’s at the Edge of wind window.</li>
<li>8’s at the power zone Edge of wind window.</li>
<li>One hand piloting.</li>
</ul>
<p>Gear: Foil Kite</p>
<p>Time: 3h</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><span class="Apple-style-span" style="color: #121416;"></div> </span></p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><span class="Apple-style-span" style="color: #121416;"><h3 id="squelch-taas-header-1" class="squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-header"><a href="#squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-content-1">Kite control and safety</a></h3><div id="squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-content-1" class="squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-content squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-content-1"></span></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">This lesson takes place on the water.</p>
<ul>
<li>Setup a Inflatable 4 line kite.</li>
<li>Introduction to the features and safety systems.</li>
<li>Quick release and bar recovery demonstration and practice.</li>
<li>First practice with a power kite.</li>
<li>Specific exercises at the edge of wind window.</li>
<li>Learn and practice assisting launch.</li>
<li>Water Priority rules.</li>
<li>Water Relaunch.</li>
<li>Body drag introduction.</li>
<li>Body drag Edge of the wind window Static.</li>
<li>Body drag Edge of the wind window 8’s.</li>
<li>Body drag One hand.</li>
<li>Body drag Power Zone.</li>
<li>Body drag board recovery.</li>
</ul>
<p>Gear: inflatable kite</p>
<p>Time:3h</p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><span class="Apple-style-span" style="color: #121416;"></div> </span></p>
<p style="text-align: left;"><span class="Apple-style-span" style="color: #121416;"><h3 id="squelch-taas-header-2" class="squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-header"><a href="#squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-content-2">Water start and board control</a></h3><div id="squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-content-2" class="squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-content squelch-taas-toggle-shortcode-content-2"></span></p>
<ul>
<li>Learn an practice landing and launching with an assistant.</li>
<li>Board preparation.</li>
<li>Water Start Theory.</li>
<li>Water Start Maneuver.</li>
<li>Water Start.</li>
<li>Self Rescue.</li>
<li>First ride.</li>
<li>Controlled Navigation.</li>
<li>Turning Maneuver.</li>
<li>Navigation in any direction.</li>
</ul>
<p>Gear: Inflatable Kite and board</p>
<p>Time: 3h</p>
</div></div>
</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">* The amount of time to take each lesson is an estimation, it can take longer or less depending on the person.</p>
